test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A ^ P’ means ‘A is the husband of P’.

‘A % P’ means ‘A is the father of P’.

‘A = P’ means ‘A is the sister of P’.

‘A & P’ means ‘A is the daughter of P’.

If B % C ^ D & E, how is B related to E?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 ^
 %
 =
 &
 
 

 Meaning
 Husband
 Father
 Sister
 Daughter
 
 

 

Given: B % C ^ D & E

It means: B is the Father of C, C is the Husband of D, D is the Daughter of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/675b6eec3a7e98a0bbce9d5020eae1630eacadcc54f74f4999decf9a17a86f70.png] 

Here, B is the '**Father of son-in-law**' of E.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
